propositions: The bugfix-size attestation gate blocks large bug fixes (>150 non-test lines) if the plan-review attestation is signed by an unpinned environment, regardless of whether the review actually passed.
A developer running plan review locally signs with their own unpinned environment ID, causing trusted_env_keyring() to return None and triggering a 'mismatch' verdict that BLOCKS the change.

No executable path exists for a contributor to obtain a prod-attested plan review: the opcert service has no client in the repo, does not persist signed envelopes, and requires an SSM-guarded API key.
The gate gates on the SOURCE of certification (who signed) via keyring verification, making it unsatisfiable for any unpinned developer environment, even when a genuine signed plan review exists.
Pinning individual developer environments (Gerrit 1355) unblocks one maintainer but does not solve the general case and leaves the failure message unremedial for new contributors.
